subject: Fairy's Ocarina
text: Saria gives Link the Fairy's Ocarina when he leaves Kokiri Forest to the west.

evidence.quote: When you leave Kokiri Forest to the west, Saria will give this to you.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: In the pot storehouse through the first door to the left in the Market, a Gold Skulltula is found inside the box at the far end.

evidence.quote:
Enter the first door to your left
to reach a pot storehouse.  There are many rupees in the pots here.  Roll
into the box at the far end to find a Gold Skulltula.

subject: Hylian Shield
text: The Hylian Shield can be purchased for 80 rupees at the Bazaar in the southeast corner of the Market.

evidence.quote:
Purchase Hylian Shield (80 rupees) (Market)
Enter the Bazaar at the southeast corner of the market, and pay the money
to get this upgraded shield.

subject: Weird Egg
text: Malon gives Link the Weird Egg next to the vines in the Hyrule Castle area, which soon hatches into a chicken.

evidence.quote:
Talk to the
girl called Malon next to the vines, and she will give you the egg.  This
will hatch into a chicken soon.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: Rolling into the lone tree near Malon at Hyrule Castle reveals a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
There is a lone tree right nearby Malon; roll into it and a Skulltula will
pop out for you to kill.

subject: Talon
text: Waking Malon's father with the chicken causes him to run off.

evidence.quote:
Wake
him up with the chicken, and he will run off.

subject: Zelda's Letter
text: Zelda gives Link her letter upon speaking with her in the courtyard.

evidence.quote:
Make your way west, past all the patrolling guards, until you get to
Zelda in the courtyard.  Talk to her and she'll give you this letter.

subject: Zelda's Lullaby
text: Impa teaches Link Zelda's Lullaby when speaking with her upon leaving.

evidence.quote: - Learn "Zelda's Lullaby" (Hyrule Castle) When you talk to Impa as you leave, she will teach you this song.

subject: Epona's Song
text: Malon teaches Link Epona's Song when he speaks to her and pulls out the Fairy Ocarina in the central ringed area.

evidence.quote:
Go to the 
central ringed area, where you will find Malon singing with her horses.  Talk
to her, then pull out your Fairy Ocarina and she will teach you this song.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: In the southwest corner of Lon Lon Ranch, pulling crates aside in a small building reveals a crawlspace leading to a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
In the southwest corner of the ranch, there is a small building you can 
enter.  Pull the crates aside to reveal a crawlspace in the northwest corner.  
Go through it to get the Heart Piece on the other side.

subject: Bottle
text: Finding the three Super Cuccos within the time limit in Talon's minigame costs 10 rupees and awards a Bottle.

evidence.quote:
Enter the house to the left of the entrance to find Talon again.  Talk to him
to play a Super Cucco hunting game for 10 rupees.  Locate the three Super 
Cuccos in the room within the time limit to get your first Bottle.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: Rolling into the lone tree between the house and the corral at Lon Lon Ranch causes a Skulltula to pop out.

evidence.quote:
There is a lone tree in-between the house and the corral area.  Roll into it
to make a Skulltula pop out.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: At night, a Skulltula appears on the wooden post on the far south side of the corral at Lon Lon Ranch.

evidence.quote:
On the far south side of the corral, this Skulltula comes out at night on the
wooded post.  Kill it and get the token.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: At night, a Skulltula appears on the back of the Know-it-all Brother's house next to the Kokiri Sword maze entrance.

evidence.quote:
On the back of the Know-it-all Brother's house, 
which is next to the Kokiri Sword maze entrance, is a Skulltula that appears
at night.

subject: Lost Woods
text: From the Lost Woods entrance, traveling east, west, east, west, forward, west, then east leads to the Sacred Forest Meadow.

evidence.quote:
From the entrance, go east, then west, then east, then west, then 
forward, then west, then east to get to the Sacred Forest Meadow.

subject: Saria's Song
text: Saria teaches Link her song in the clearing of the Sacred Forest Meadow.

evidence.quote:
Make your way through the linear 
maze, avoiding the Deku Scrubs, and up through the narrow path until you 
reach a clearing.  Saria is waiting here, and she teaches you her song.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Going west from the Lost Woods entrance and playing Saria's Song on the stump earns a Heart Piece from the Skull Kid.

evidence.quote:
From the entrance to the Lost Woods, go west.  Step on the stump and play 
Saria's Song, and the Skull Kid gives you a Heart Piece.

subject: Deku Stick Holder
text: Defeating the Deku Scrub past the bridge south of the Skull Kid allows Link to buy the 20 Capacity Deku Stick Holder for 40 rupees.

evidence.quote:
- Get 20 Capacity Deku Stick Holder (40 rupees) (Lost Woods)
From the last Heart Piece, go south.  Drop down and go past the bridge, then
defeat the Deku Scrub.  He sells you the Deku Stick upgrade for 40 rupees.

subject: Deku Seed Holder
text: Shooting the bulls-eye plate three times with the Slingshot in the room east of the Lost Woods entrance awards the 40 Capacity Deku Seed Holder.

evidence.quote:
- Get 40 Capacity Deku Seed Holder (Lost Woods)
From the Lost Woods entrance, go east.  Shoot the bulls-eye plate three times
with the Slingshot to get this Deku Seed upgrade.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Repeating the Ocarina tunes played by the Skull Kids three times correctly awards a Heart Piece.

evidence.quote:
Stand on the stump, and play the 
Ocarina for the Skull Kids.  Follow the tunes they play, and do it three 
times correctly to get a Heart Piece.

subject: Bottle
text: Returning all seven chickens to the Cucco Lady's fenced pen in Kakariko Village rewards Link with a Bottle.

evidence.quote:
Talk to the Cucco Lady in the south portion of the village- you 
need to find all seven of her chickens and dump them into her fenced area....When all the chickens are 
returned, the lady will give you a Bottle as a reward.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Paying Dampe 10 rupees to dig at night in the Graveyard can reveal a Heart Piece in one of the holes.

evidence.quote:
At night, go to the Graveyard, southeast from Kakariko Village.  Talk to Dampe
and play his digging game.  Pay him 10 rupees at any spot and he will dig a 
hole.  There is a Heart Piece in one of the spots he can dig.

subject: Sun's Song
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby next to the huge gravestone in the Graveyard reveals a hole where reading the plaque teaches the Sun's Song, allowing the player to switch between day and night at any time.

evidence.quote:
Go to the far east, top-most ledge of the Graveyard, and play Zelda's Lullaby
next to the huge gravestone.  It will disappear and you can jump in the hole....Examine the plaque at the end of the path to learn this
song; you can now switch between day and night at any time.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Pulling aside a small gravestone on the ledge south of the royal tomb reveals a hole with a mummy and a chest containing a Heart Piece.

evidence.quote:
On the ledge just south of where the huge gravestone was, pull aside the small
gravestones on the left-hand side.  One of them hides a secret hole; jump 
inside it.  Kill the mummy inside, then play the Song of Soul and get the 
Heart Piece from the chest that appears.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: Placing a bottled bug on the soft soil in the northwest corner ledge of the Graveyard causes a Gold Skulltula to appear.

evidence.quote:
Catch a bug from under a rock with a Bottle, and go up on the ledge to the 
northwest corner of the Graveyard.  Lay a bug on the soft soil, and a Gold 
Skulltula pops out.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: Rolling into the tree just past the entrance from Hyrule Field in Kakariko Village makes a Gold Skulltula fall out.

evidence.quote:
Roll into the tree just past the entrance from Hyrule Field to make this Gold
Skulltula fall out.

subject: Adult Wallet
text: Collecting 10 Skulltula Tokens unlocks the Adult Wallet inside the House of Skulltula, which allows Link to carry up to 200 rupees.

evidence.quote:
Once you have 10 Skulltula Tokens, enter the House of Skulltula just right of
the entrance from Hyrule Field.  The man inside will give you the Adult 
Wallet, which lets you hold up to 200 rupees.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: At night, a Gold Skulltula can be shot and collected from the tall watchtower in Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote:
At night, go up to the tall watchtower in the village.  Look up and shoot the
Gold Skulltula, then climb up to get the token.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: A Skulltula is on the back of the house located just to the left of the exit leading to Death Mountain.

evidence.quote:
This Skulltula is on the back of the house just to the left of the exit that
leads to Death Mountain.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: A Skulltula is behind one of the brick walls of the building under construction in the center of Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote:
Examine the building under construction in the center of the village.  A 
Skulltula is behind one of the brick walls.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: A Skulltula is found on the back of the House of Skulltula in Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote: Look at the back of the House of Skulltula to find this one.

subject: Deku Seed Holder
text: Winning the Archery Game in the northwest corner of the Market awards the 50 Capacity Deku Seed Holder upgrade for the Slingshot.

evidence.quote:
- Get 50 Capacity Deku Seed Holder (Market)	
Leave Kakariko Village and go to the Market area.  In the northwest corner of
the market, enter the Archery Game building.  Win the game to get this 
upgrade for the Slingshot.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Luring the white dog to the woman inside the second door of the southwest back alley at night rewards Link with a Heart Piece.

evidence.quote:
Inside the market, play the Sun Song to make it nighttime.  In the main area,
there are a lot of dogs hopping around; approach the white-colored dog so
that it starts to follow you.  Now enter the back alley of the market to the
southwest, and enter the second door.  The woman inside will give you the 
Heart Piece for finding her dog.

subject: Keaton Mask
text: The Keaton Mask becomes available at the Happy Mask Shop after giving Zelda's letter to the guard at the Death Mountain gate, and can be sold to him in Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote:
The Happy Mask Shop in the market opens up after you have spoken to the man
guarding the gate to Death Mountain and given him Zelda's letter.  Inside, 
talk to the store owner to get the Keaton Mask, the first mask.  To sell the
mask, give it to the man guarding the gate in Kakariko Village.

subject: Skull Mask
text: After selling the Keaton Mask, the Skull Mask can be obtained from the Happy Mask Shop and sold to the Skull Kid in the Lost Woods west of the entrance.

evidence.quote:
After selling the Keaton Mask, the Skull Mask is available in the Happy Mask
Shop.  To sell it, enter the Lost Woods from Kokiri Forest.  Go west from the
entrance and talk to the Skull Kid with the mask on.

subject: Deku Stick Holder
text: Navigating east, west, east, west, then west in the Lost Woods, dropping into the hole in tall grass, and wearing the Skull Mask causes Deku Scrubs to give Link the 30 Capacity Deku Stick Holder.

evidence.quote:
- Get 30 Capacity Deku Stick Holder (Lost Woods)
From the Lost Woods entrance, go east, west, east, west, then west again.  
Drop into the hole in the tall grass near the butterflies.  Wear the Skull 
Mask, then step forward in this secret forest stage.  The Deku Scrubs will 
sprout out of the ground and give you this Deku Stick upgrade.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: Releasing a bug onto the soft soil behind the item shop in Kokiri Forest makes a Skulltula emerge.

evidence.quote:
Get a bug from under a rock and catch it with your bottle, then go over behind
the item shop in the Kokiri Forest.  Lay the bug onto the soft soil here to
make a Skulltula pop out.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: Going west twice from the Lost Woods entrance and putting a bug onto the soft soil near the bridge reveals a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
From the Lost Woods entrance, go west, and west again to the bridge area.  Lay
a bug at the soft soil at the ledge to reveal a Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: Releasing a bug onto the soft soil in the Lost Woods screen with two Deku Scrubs fetches out a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
At the Lost Woods screen with the two Deku Scrubs shooting at you, there is a
soft soil spot.  Use another bug here to fetch out a Skulltula.

subject: Spooky Mask
text: The Spooky Mask from the Happy Mask Shop can be sold to the boy in the Graveyard during the day.

evidence.quote:
Get the Spooky Mask from the Happy Mask Shop.  To sell it, go to the Graveyard
from Kakariko Village during the day, and give this to the boy there.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Catching a big fish of about 10 pounds at the Fishing Pond in Lake Hylia earns a Heart Piece from the owner.

evidence.quote:
If you can catch a big fish (about 10 pounds), the owner will give you
a Heart Piece.  The big fish usually lurks between the log poking out in the
middle of the pond and the three sticks nearby.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: Dropping a bug on the soft soil next to the Scientist's Lab in Lake Hylia reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
The Scientist's Lab is to the right of the entrance from Hyrule Field.  Use a
bug on the soft soil next to the lab.

subject: Banooru
text: Playing an Ocarina song in front of the dancing scarecrow named Banooru in the scarecrow patch between the lab and the fishing pond sets up notes that become important later.

evidence.quote:
While you are in this area, there is a scarecrow patch in between the lab and
the fishing pond.  Play a song with 
your Ocarina in front of the dancing scarecrow named Banooru, and remember 
the notes you used; it will become important later.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: A Gold Skulltula is located on a small platform deep in Lake Hylia across both bridges.

evidence.quote:
Go all the way across both bridges, then swim to the small platform out deep
in the lake.  Kill the Gold Skulltula there.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: Rolling into the tree near the entrance to Zora's River knocks down a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Roll into
the tree near the entrance to make a Gold Skulltula fall out.

subject: Stone of Agony
text: Returning to the House of Skulltula with 20 Skulltula Tokens rewards Link with the Stone of Agony, which alerts him when a secret is nearby.

evidence.quote:
Enter the House of Skulltula in Kakariko Village again once you have 20 
Skulltula Tokens, and the newly uncursed man inside gives you this item, 
which alerts you when a secret is nearby.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Floating down with a chicken through the giant waterfall on the right near the bridge in Gerudo Valley leads to a Heart Piece in a nook.

evidence.quote:
Near the impassable
bridge, grab the chicken.  Jump off to the right and float down, through the
giant waterfall, into a tiny nook in the wall.  Get the Heart Piece here.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: Using a bottled bug on the soft soil spot on the bottom ledge of Gerudo Valley digs up a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Jump into the water from the last Heart Piece, then climb up on the bottom
ledge of the valley.  Use a bottled bug on the soft soil spot here to dig up
a Gold Skulltula.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Floating to the tiny ledge on the opposite side of Gerudo Valley with a chicken and rolling into the crate yields a Heart Piece.

evidence.quote:
Grab the chicken again, and jump off the cliff to the left.  Float to the 
tiny ledge with the crate on the opposite side of the valley.  Roll into the 
crate and get the Heart Piece.

subject: Power Bracelet
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby to enter Darunia's room and then playing Saria's Song for him earns Link the Power Bracelet.

evidence.quote:
Drop down to the bottom level of the city, and play
Zelda's Lullaby in front of the big door slab.  Go inside to find Darunia,
leader of the Gorons.  Play Saria's Song for him, and he will give you the
Power Bracelet.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: Throwing a bomb flower over the ledge destroys the boulder blocking Dodongo's Cavern, revealing a soft soil spot where a bug releases a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Pick up the bomb flower and throw it
over the ledge so that it explodes and destroys the boulder blocking the 
entrance to Dodongo's Cavern.  Go back down there, and you will see a soft
soil spot.  Use a bug here to release a Skulltula
